tools.name: subscriptions_find
tools.description: Finds subscriptions and other recurring charges in a bank or card statement CSV, with billing cycle, yearly cost, price increases and possible double charges. Use to audit spending or find what to cancel. Read-only, and never uses the network. Results include merchant names and amounts from the file, so they reach the model. It can't cancel anything.

path.description: Path to the bank or card statement CSV

columns.description: Column names by field (date, amount, credit, debit, description), when detection fails

date_format.description: dmy or mdy, needed only if the tool reports that dates are ambiguous

positive_out.description: Set if the file shows charges as positive numbers, as many card statements do

limit.description: Most findings to return, default 100. 0 returns only the totals

tools.name: subscriptions_inspect_csv
tools.description: Shows which columns chargescout detects in a statement CSV and how many rows it can read, without returning row contents. Use if the file is unfamiliar or nothing was found.
